# Michael Willi

> Michael Willi is a sophomore at Indiana University Bloomington, Class of 2029, and the founder of Uh Oh, a zinc cold remedy brand he is building in the IU Innovates Incubator. He founded two companies in 2026, Impact Margin and Brine Prospect, wrote a venture thesis on lithium from Permian Basin produced water, and is exploring private markets, strategy, and product. He is based in Bloomington, Indiana during the school year and Austin, Texas in the summer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://michaelwilli.com/): Short introduction and contact links.
- [About Michael Willi](https://michaelwilli.com/about): Full background, Uh Oh, Brine Prospect, Impact Margin, research and writing, education, quick facts, and common questions.

## Key facts

- School: Indiana University Bloomington, B.S. in Merchandising and Product Development (Eskenazi School), studying Product Development within the Merchandising program, Business Minor (Kelley School of Business), Class of 2029.
- Now: Founder of Uh Oh (https://uhohbrands.com/), a zinc cold remedy brand positioned as the obvious thing to take at the first sign of a cold, built in the IU Innovates Incubator. Also working through Wall Street Prep's Excel, accounting, and financial modeling courses.
- Previously: Founder of Brine Prospect (October 2026), a mail-in lithium test kit for oilfield brine with a lithium lease value calculator, stopped after customer discovery showed operators already get lithium in their free water analysis. Founder and CEO of Impact Margin (April to September 2026), software that read a business's operating and utility bills and flagged overbilling, cost spikes, and late fees. Legal assistant at Willi Law Firm in Austin, Texas.
- Writing: "Reduce, Reuse, Recycle... Profit?", a venture thesis on lithium from Permian Basin produced water, second edition July 2026. Retention research and re-engagement strategy for Roblox, a survey of 59 Indiana University students, October 2026.
- Recognition: 4.0 GPA, Executive Dean's List, Eagle Scout.
- Looking for: Summer 2027 internships in private markets, strategy, and product.
